title: Project Notes
description:
Short write-ups mapped to projects in this portfolio.
Click a card to open the related project page.

posts.title: OCR Handwritten Text Extraction — Bank Deposit Forms
posts.excerpt: Built an end-to-end OCR pipeline combining YOLOv8 field detection, OpenCV preprocessing, and transformer-based handwritten OCR to extract structured data from bank deposit forms.

posts.title: Multi-tenant HR Management Application
posts.excerpt: Designed a scalable tenant-isolated HRMS with dynamic URN-based routing, UUID-based data modeling, Redis caching, and Dockerized deployment workflows.

posts.title: Insurance Web Application
posts.excerpt: Built a full-featured insurance platform with NextAuth authentication, policy and claims workflows, role-based dashboards, premium payments, and CI/CD deployment on AWS.

posts.title: Blog Web Application
posts.excerpt: Created a publishing platform with authentication, rich authoring, tagging, and real-time nested comments backed by Prisma—deployed with a split static + backend hosting setup on AWS.

posts.title: Civil Construction Project Management Application
posts.excerpt: Developed a construction collaboration tool with drawing workflows and a Three.js viewing pipeline, including CAD→PDF conversion, WebGL optimizations, annotations, and redline markups.

posts.title: CMA Firm Website — Strategy-Led UI & Conversion Design
posts.excerpt: Designed and developed a modern corporate website for a CMA and accounting firm, translating complex services into a clear, trust-driven experience with conversion-focused layout and CTAs.
